uncited: It is distinguished from its sibling [Gaussian Splatting](946-gaussian-splatting.md) by its explicit dependency on a parametric structural prior to drive deformation, and from [Gaussian Avatars](1477-gaussian-avatars.md) which typically focus on head-only reconstruction using the FLAME model.
The method originates from the application of 3D Gaussian Splatting to dynamic human reconstruction.
